titles.title: Untitled (Red and Pink)

description: Advertisement for Cheney Silks. The artwork shows an abstract composition of fluid, flame-like shapes in varying shades of red and pink. Below the image, text reads: “The Reds of fashion suggest the restless, fickle movement of flames—a color quality captured in this painting by Georgia O’Keeffe.” The brand name “CHENEY SILKS” appears prominently at center, with fabric color names listed along the bottom: ORIGLO, ROSAN, FLAMBIC, GRAGON, SHERIL, VINTE.
imageCaption: Image has not been color proofed to current standards, and its colors may differ from the original work. The Museum will replace it when new photography becomes available.
